cohort: The study included all antenatal and parturient women admitted to a single tertiary center from April to August 2020.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic indirectly led to adverse effects on maternal and child health, including a reduction in institutional deliveries, inadequate antenatal visits, increased high-risk pregnancies, and a rise in ICU admissions, primarily due to delayed health-seeking caused by lockdown and fear of infection.
